title: Acquisition of SIB(s) or posSIB(s) in RRC_CONNECTED

entities.name: SIB/posSIB Acquisition in RRC_CONNECTED
entities.description: Procedure for UE in RRC_CONNECTED state to acquire required System Information Blocks (SIBs) or positioning SIBs (posSIBs) either via broadcast or on-demand request.

entities.name: RRC_CONNECTED
entities.description: RRC state where UE has an active connection with the network.

entities.name: Active BWP without common search space for other SI
entities.description: Condition where UE's active BWP is not configured with common search space containing searchSpaceOtherSystemInformation field.

entities.name: Active BWP with common search space for other SI
entities.description: Condition where UE's active BWP is configured with common search space containing searchSpaceOtherSystemInformation field.

entities.name: si-BroadcastStatus set to broadcasting
entities.description: Condition where System Information broadcast status indicates the SI is being broadcast.

entities.name: si-BroadcastStatus set to notBroadcasting
entities.description: Condition where System Information broadcast status indicates the SI is not being broadcast.

entities.name: posSI-BroadcastStatus set to broadcasting
entities.description: Condition where positioning System Information broadcast status indicates the posSI is being broadcast.

entities.name: posSI-BroadcastStatus set to notBroadcasting
entities.description: Condition where positioning System Information broadcast status indicates the posSI is not being broadcast.

entities.name: onDemandSIB-Request configured and T350 not running
entities.description: Condition where on-demand SIB request is configured and timer T350 is not currently running.

entities.name: DedicatedSIBRequest
entities.description: Message sent by UE to request on-demand System Information Blocks.

entities.name: T350
entities.description: Timer used to prohibit frequent on-demand SIB requests, set to onDemandSIB-RequestProhibitTimer value.

entities.name: Acquire SI message
entities.description: Action where UE acquires System Information messages as defined in the specification.

relations.description: The SIB acquisition procedure requires UE to be in RRC_CONNECTED state.
Procedure behavior is guarded by condition of no common search space for other SI.
Procedure behavior is guarded by condition of common search space presence for other SI.
When on-demand is configured and T350 not running, UE initiates DedicatedSIBRequest transmission.
When on-demand is configured and T350 not running, UE starts timer T350.
When SI broadcast status is broadcasting, UE acquires the SI message.
When SI is not broadcasting, procedure is further guarded by on-demand configuration and T350 status.
When positioning SI broadcast status is broadcasting, UE acquires the SI message.
When positioning SI is not broadcasting, procedure is further guarded by on-demand configuration and T350 status.
